import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectiveCoordinateNonvanishing
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalRatioHyperplane

/-!
# Linear forms on standard projective charts

The regular function representing a linear form in the frame `X_i` is the
corresponding scalar combination of the coordinate ratios `X_j / X_i`.
Its basic open is the intersection of that chart with the complement of the
projective hyperplane.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization
open AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne.ProjectiveTwist

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {J : Type} [Fintype J]

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

omit [Fintype J] in
/-- The canonical structure map on a standard projective chart induces the
coefficient algebra map into homogeneous localization. -/
theorem structureMap_appTop_awayToSection (i : J) :
    (Proj.toSpecZero (homogeneousSubmodule J k) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (homogeneousSubmodule J k 0)))).appTop ≫
        (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : chart (k := k) i ≤ ⊤)).op =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i))) ≫
        Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i) := by
  let A := homogeneousSubmodule J k
  let p := Proj.toSpecZero A ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (A 0)))
  have hiota : (chart (k := k) i).ι =
      Proj.basicOpenToSpec A (X i) ≫ Proj.awayι A (X i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.one_pos := by
    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι A (X i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.one_pos,
      ← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom A (X i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.one_pos,
      Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have haway : Proj.awayι A (X i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.one_pos ≫ p =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (Away A (X i)))) := by
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    rfl
  have h1 : (chart (k := k) i).ι ≫ p =
      Proj.basicOpenToSpec A (X i) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (Away A (X i)))) := by
    rw [hiota, Category.assoc, haway]
  have h2 := congrArg Scheme.Hom.appTop h1
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at h2
  have h3 : (Proj.basicOpenToSpec A (X i)).appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).hom ≫ Proj.awayToSection A (X i) ≫
        (chart (k := k) i).topIso.inv :=
    Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top A (X i)
  rw [h3, Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality_assoc] at h2
  have h4 : (chart (k := k) i).ι.appTop ≫
      (chart (k := k) i).topIso.hom =
      (Proj A).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chart (k := k) i ≤ ⊤)).op := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appTop, Scheme.Opens.topIso_hom, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
    exact congrArg _ (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
  have h5 := congr($h2 ≫ (chart (k := k) i).topIso.hom)
  rw [Category.assoc, h4] at h5
  simpa only [p, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id] using h5

private theorem linearForm_away_eq_sum (i : J) (c : J → k) :
    Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one (k := k) i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule c) =
      ∑ j, algebraMap k (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)) (c j) *
        ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord i j := by
  classical
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [← HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    ← HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_val, Away.isLocalizationElem, Away.val_mk,
    ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord, pow_one, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm, Localization.mk_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [Localization.mk_eq_mk', ← IsLocalization.mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul]

/-- A homogeneous linear form divided by `X_i` is the same scalar combination
of the regular coordinates `X_j / X_i`. -/
theorem linearFormRatio_eq_sum (i : J) (c : J → k) :
    (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
        (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i)
          (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule c)) =
      ∑ j, (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
          (algebraMap k (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)) (c j)) *
        coordinate i j := by
  rw [linearForm_away_eq_sum]
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, coordinate]

/-- The local coefficient of a linear form is nonzero exactly on the
intersection of the standard chart and its projective basic open. -/
theorem basicOpen_linearFormRatio (i : J) (c : J → k) :
    (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen
        (∑ j, (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
            (algebraMap k (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)) (c j)) *
          coordinate i j) =
      chart i ⊓ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm c) := by
  rw [← linearFormRatio_eq_sum]
  exact basicOpen_homogeneousRatio i _
    (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule c) Nat.one_pos

end
end Hartshorne.ProjectiveTwist
